subject: Shiny running on Heroku (but not graphs)

messages.author: 8838a40e1b0a45ac
messages.subject: Shiny running on Heroku (but not graphs)
parts:
Hi all,

I've managed to get Shiny running on Heroku.  See http://shiny-example-2.herokuapp.com/.  It's not all roses yet.  Details:
  • The repository for that app is at https://bitbucket.org/btubbs/shiny-example-2.  Feel free to clone and hack on it.
  • I forked virtualstaticvoid's existing heroku-buildpack-r, updated it to 3.0.2, took out the building via Vulcan and just used a shell from "heroku run /bin/bash" to rebuild R myself.  The resulting buildpack is at https://github.com/yougov/heroku-buildpack-r.  The R build script is in support/build-r in that repo.
  • I'm just using Shiny, not Shiny Server.  So to make this work you have to opt your app into the public beta of Heroku's websockets feature. See https://blog.heroku.com/archives/2013/10/8/websockets-public-beta.
  • The app seems to go to sleep after a minute or two of inactivity (a gray overlay covers the page).  I'm not sure if that's a limitation of doing Websockets through Heroku or if they're just putting the dyno to sleep because I'm at the free single-instance tier.  I might try running under shiny-server to work around that.
  • I've compiled X11 support into R, but it seems that getting graphics to work requires an X server to actually be running, which Heroku doesn't have.  To demonstrate, I've put up an app with the first example from the tutorial at http://shiny-example-1.herokuapp.com/.  The graph fails to appear, with the error "unable to start device PNG" in red.  A look at the logs shows that it's dying when trying to contact an X11 display.  See http://pastie.org/8451506.
Is there a way to get R to generate PNGs without needing an X server running?

Thanks,
Brent

Hi Brent,
We are also working on an offering that we will start opening in a closed alpha this week which allows you to run Shiny apps in the cloud.  It is very much modeled after Heroku.  If folks are interested in being part of the alpha, please register at: http://shinyapps.io/   We will reach out to folks and hopefully we can get everyone trying it out and giving us feedback in the coming months.  

Best,
Tareef
